market_summary: USD strength and broad risk-off flows dominate the London/NY overlap session. XAUUSD and BTCUSD are displaying strong downward momentum expansions below their respective session Value Areas, VWAPs, and ATR lower bands with confirming negative CVD. Meanwhile, EURUSD and GBPUSD remain compressed inside Value Areas oscillating around VWAP and POC, warranting patience.

signals.rationale: Price is significantly below VAL (3943.91) and POC (3978.00). CVD is BEARISH (-8.25) with a negative slope (-2.19) confirming persistent selling pressure during the active LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Structure remains heavily bearish below both downward-sloping VWAP (3958.57) and EMA50 (3950.51). Recent candles broke through previous Session Low support at 3882.79 with strong yellow RVOL spikes (last rvol 1.861, recent spike count 6), pushing well past the lower ATR band (3907.24). With GEX null and no immediate structural floor, momentum favors trend continuation downward.
signals.level_event: rejection of lower ATR band bounce into breakdown

lucid_plan.sizing: fixed target 1.3 reaches $627 net with 5 GC (risk $1400)

signals.rationale: Price trades inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10801 to VAH 1.10976) right at POC (1.10928). CVD is NEUTRAL (+5,505) during the LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Price sits narrowly between VWAP (1.10864) and EMA50 (1.10887) in the mid-channel of the ATR band (1.10739 - 1.11025). Volume shows no recent yellow RVOL breakout bar (rvol_last 1.574). Lacking directional edge and trapped between Session High (1.11027) and Prev Low (1.10824), setup warrants HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral hovering near session VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance inside Value Area near POC

signals.rationale: Price trades inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32587 to VAH 1.32766) below POC (1.32726). While CVD is BEARISH (-6,596), cvd_slope is slightly positive (+1,214) indicating fading selling pressure during the LONDON_NY_OVERLAP session. Price is tightly coiling around flat VWAP (1.32657) and EMA50 (1.32677) within the middle of the ATR envelope, resting on minor S/R 1.32661 without RVOL confirmation (rvol_last 1.609). Lacking expansion or clear directional drive, hold is advised.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral pinned at VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (73258.06) and session POC (73527.67). CVD is BEARISH (-0.07) with negative slope (-0.01) aligning with the trend during LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is decisively below VWAP (73340.67) and EMA50 (73227.68), trading underneath the lower ATR channel (72315.30). The forming bar broke cleanly below previous Session Low (72055.20), accompanied by strong prior yellow RVOL expansion bars. Setup displays clear momentum continuation into low-volume air pocket.
